step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an AWS customer account interacting with the Kaleido blockchain platform. Incoming event payloads in Amazon SQS trigger an AWS Lambda function, which routes transactions securely via AWS PrivateLink to Kaleido's EthConnect REST API layer. AWS KMS is used to store and manage master keys accessed by Kaleido. Additionally, Amazon CloudWatch and Amazon S3 are configured within the AWS account for log streaming and data backups.
